verdicts.reason: A keeps the product in its cream circle, but the circle is jammed into the top-left corner and touches the canvas edges. The subhead is indented away from the headline's left edge, and the NEW and Try It buttons sit in a right-aligned stack that shares no edge with the left-aligned text, so the layout zig-zags. B has a clean left-aligned text column and a good button row, but it fails on fidelity: the cream circle has come off the product and been dumped as a stray circle clipped at the bottom-left corner, and the bottle now melts into the orange background, leaving only a faint outline.
